description: Aggregate sensing, service, QC, and alignment values from one controlled labelled UGRR pilot window.
privacy_review: Aggregate-only review passed; timestamps, spatial detail, equipment and network labels, logs, and record-level signals were excluded.
claim_boundary: One controlled labelled absolute pilot window; descriptive aggregate only. It is not a paired action effect, canonical table, model-training, efficacy, uncertainty-calibration, occupancy, or generalization evidence.
